name: Simulated exposure surface, correlation length 100 m

spatialCoverage.name: Los Angeles, California, United States (10 km window)

description: SIMULATED exposure surface used to check the geocoding stress test of the OHDSI GIS benchmark through Gaia: a Gaussian random field with exponential covariance and correlation length 100 m (mean 9, SD 1.9 ug/m3), rendered as a 25 m square grid over a 10 km window around downtown Los Angeles. It is not a measurement of any real exposure. The field is built from random Fourier features in the postGIS step.

about.name: ETL process for the simulated exposure surface
about.description: The random Fourier features (w1, w2, phase) are published as a CSV and loaded into a temporary table; the square grid is created in EPSG:5070 with ST_SquareGrid and the value of every cell is computed at its centre.

variableMeasured.name: pm25_surface
variableMeasured.description: Simulated exposure at the cell centre. Static over 2014-2019.
